preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is between 1 and 20,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(2 <= n <= 100000 for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() and line.split()[0].isdigit() and int(line.split()[0]) == n)
preconditions.description: For each test case, the number of vertices n is between 2 and 100,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= S <= 10**16 for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() and line.split()[0].isdigit() and int(line.split()[0]) == n)
preconditions.description: For each test case, the maximum sum S is between 1 and 10^16 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == 4 for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() and line.split()[0].isdigit() and int(line.split()[0]) == n and line.split()[1].isdigit())
preconditions.description: Each edge description line has exactly four integers: v_i, u_i, w_i, c_i.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= v_i <= n and 1 <= u_i <= n for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() and line.split()[0].isdigit() and int(line.split()[0]) == n and line.split()[1].isdigit() and len(line.split()) == 4)
preconditions.description: For each edge, vertices v_i and u_i are between 1 and n inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= w_i <= 10**6 for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() and line.split()[0].isdigit() and int(line.split()[0]) == n and line.split()[1].isdigit() and len(line.split()) == 4)
preconditions.description: For each edge, weight w_i is between 1 and 1,000,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= c_i <= 2 for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() and line.split()[0].isdigit() and int(line.split()[0]) == n and line.split()[1].isdigit() and len(line.split()) == 4)
preconditions.description: For each edge, cost c_i is either 1 or 2.

preconditions.expression: all(v_i != u_i for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() and line.split()[0].isdigit() and int(line.split()[0]) == n and line.split()[1].isdigit() and len(line.split()) == 4)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two distinct vertices.

postconditions.expression: all(output_line.strip().isdigit() for output_line in stdout.splitlines() if output_line.strip())
postconditions.description: Each output line is a non-negative integer representing the minimum total cost for the corresponding test case.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= int(output_line) <= 2 * 10**6 for output_line in stdout.splitlines() if output_line.strip())
postconditions.description: Each output cost is a non-negative integer bounded by the maximum possible cost (2 * 10^6).
The number of output lines equals the number of test cases t.

postconditions.expression: all(calculate_sum_of_paths(edges, n, S) <= S for edges, n, S in parse_test_cases(stdin))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the sum of weights of paths from the root to each leaf after applying the minimum cost moves is at most S.

postconditions.expression: all(min_cost == min_total_cost(edges, n, S) for edges, n, S, min_cost in zip(parse_test_cases(stdin), [int(line) for line in stdout.splitlines() if line.strip()]))
postconditions.description: The output cost for each test case is the minimum total cost required to make the sum of weights of paths from the root to each leaf at most S.
